transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hello. Well... I suppose I'm just having some trouble settling down. For the past year or so, I just find myself always puttering around... fixing things, arranging. Volunteering for one more thing. I don't really know why, but even at 87, I just... I have a hard time just sitting down and being still.
Has this difficulty sitting still come in distinct periods when you were much more active than usual?
No... I don't think so. It doesn't really come and go like that. It's just... pretty much all the time.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot, even when there isn’t anything specific wrong?
No... not really. I don't tend to worry about things.
Have you been having trouble with your memory?
No... I don't believe so. My memory seems fine.
Have you been this way since you were young?

Yes. I suppose so. I remember... well, getting scolded in grade school. For getting out of my seat too much, or talking over the other children. They said I was... too lively, I think. Long before I was a teenager.
Do you feel a strong need to have things done in a very particular or orderly way?
No... not really. I don't pay much mind to that sort of thing. I just do things however they get done.
